Game Overview

In What is the Color?, the core idea is straightforward: "What is the Color?" is an engaging and interactive experience for young children, combining vibrant visuals with auditory cues. Kids match sounds to colors, enhancing their recognition skills and providing an exciting challenge as difficulty increases. Ideal for ages 2-7, it fosters learning through playful exploration.
